querystring.select: SELECT RM.DESCR AS MrCustModelCode , RP.PROFESSION_NAME AS ProfessionName, RMPOS.DESCR AS JobPosition, RMSTAT.DESCR AS JobStatus, CPJD.COY_NAME AS CoyName,  CPJD.IS_MF_EMP AS InternalEmp,RMCOYSCALE.DESCR AS CoyScale, CPJD.JOB_TITLE_NAME AS JobTitleName, RIT.INDUSTRY_TYPE_NAME AS IndustryTypeName, CPJD.EMPLOYMENT_ESTABLISHMENT_DT AS EmploymentEstablishmentDt
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST CU WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.CUST_PERSONAL_JOB_DATA CPJD WITH(NOLOCK) ON CPJD.CUST_ID = CU.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_INDUSTRY_TYPE RIT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RIT.REF_INDUSTRY_TYPE_ID = CPJD.REF_INDUSTRY_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_PROFESSION RP WITH(NOLOCK) ON RP.REF_PROFESSION_ID = CPJD.REF_PROFESSION_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER AS RM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CU.MR_CUST_MODEL_CODE = RM.MASTER_CODE AND 'CUST_MODEL' = RM.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMPOS WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMPOS.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE='JOB_POSITION' AND RMPOS.MASTER_CODE = CPJD.MR_JOB_POSITION_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMSTAT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMSTAT.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE='JOB_STAT' AND RMSTAT.MASTER_CODE = CPJD.MR_JOB_STAT_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMCOYSCALE WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMCOYSCALE.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE='COMPANY_SCALE' AND RMCOYSCALE.MASTER_CODE = CPJD.MR_COY_SCALE_CODE
